name: Cushion The Blow [Psionic]
body:
You reduce the damage of an attack on an ally.

Prerequisite: Wisdom 15, collective class feature, manifester level 6th.

Benefit: As long as you are maintaining psionic focus, as an immediate action, you can minimize the damage of a single attack with a ranged, melee, or natural weapon or unarmed strike (treat all dice rolled as 1s) on any member of the collective. This ability must be used in response to an attack on a member of the collective. In addition, if you expend your psionic focus, you can reduce any additional damage on the attack (such as bonus damage from a high Strength or sneak attack damage) by your key ability modifier.
